title: track_follow
description: Turn tracking on: the camera follows a person by itself. Who: target person-3 (an id from track_observe), largest or central, or point {x, y} where somebody tapped the picture, 0 to 1 from the top left.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: The camera's id. May be left out when there is only one camera.

framing.title: Framing
framing.description: close is head and shoulders, waist is from the waist up, full is the whole person, wide is the person and the space around them.

point.description: Follow whoever is nearest this point of the picture.
